        # Not used directly for safety; merge logic handles orientation by reversing whole route.
        pass

    # Merge procedure
    for s, i, j in savings:
        ri = route_of.get(i, -1)
        rj = route_of.get(j, -1)
        if ri < 0 or rj < 0 or ri == rj:
            continue
        ri_list = routes[ri]
        rj_list = routes[rj]
        load = route_load[ri] + route_load[rj]
        if load > capacity:
            continue

        i_front, i_back = ri_list[0], ri_list[-1]
        j_front, j_back = rj_list[0], rj_list[-1]

        merged = False
        new_route = None

        # Case 1: i is back end and j is front end => i ... + j ...
        if i_back == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list
            merged = True
        # Case 2: i is back end and j is back end => i ... + reverse(j route)
        elif i_back == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True
        # Case 3: i is front end and j is front end => reverse(i route) + j ...
        elif i_front == i and j_front == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list
            merged = True
        # Case 4: i is front end and j is back end => reverse(i route) + reverse(j route)? Actually
        # want ... + ... with i at appropriate end:
        # i_front == i means route starts with i. To connect to j_back == j, we need reverse(i route)??:
        # If we reverse i route, i moves to back end. Then i_back (after reverse) matches i, and j_back matches j at end of j route,
        # but we need j at front end for direct concatenation, so reverse j route.
        elif i_front == i and j_back == j:
            new_route = ri_list[::-1] + rj_list[::-1]
            merged = True

        if not merged:
            continue

        # Apply merge: mark rj removed and update mappings.
        routes[ri] = new_route
        route_load[ri] = load
        # Update route_of for nodes in rj
        for node in rj_list:
            route_of[node] = ri
        routes[rj] = None

    routes = [r for r in routes if r is not None]

    # Local search: deterministic relocate between routes (conservative, maintains feasibility)
    # Use limited passes to keep runtime bounded.
    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for k in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]]
        return c

    # Precompute loads
    loads = [sum(demands[node] for node in r) for r in routes]
    # Cost cache
    costs = [route_cost(r) for r in routes]

    # Build customer position lookup per route for fast removals not needed; we do simple scans.
    # Attempt improvements: move single customer from one route into another at best feasible position.
    # Keep only first improving move per (from_route, to_route) in deterministic order.
    max_passes = 2
    for _ in range(max_passes):
        improved_any = False
        R = len(routes)
        # If too many routes (can happen in bottleneck cases), relocate may help; still deterministic.
        for a in range(R):
            ra = routes[a]
            if not ra:
                continue
            for idx in range(len(ra)):
                node = ra[idx]
                # Remove node from ra
                for b in range(R):
                    if b == a:
                        continue
                    rb = routes[b]
                    if rb is None:
                        continue
                    if loads[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue

                    # Determine best insertion position in rb that reduces total cost (or smallest increase, but accept only improving)
                    # Compute cost delta efficiently by trying positions.
                    base_cost_a = costs[a]
                    base_cost_b = costs[b]

                    # Cost of removing node from ra:
                    # recompute by cases in O(1) using neighbors
                    left = ra[idx - 1] if idx - 1 >= 0 else depot
                    right = ra[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < len(ra) else depot
                    # edge left->node and node->right removed; edge left->right added
                    rem_delta_a = -matrix[left][node] - matrix[node][right] + matrix[left][right]
                    new_cost_a = base_cost_a + rem_delta_a

                    # insertion into rb at position p (between rb[p-1] and rb[p]), p in [0..len(rb)]
                    # try all positions deterministically; pick best improving.
                    best_delta = None
                    best_p = None
                    Lrb = len(rb)
                    for p in range(Lrb + 1):
                        ins_left = rb[p - 1] if p - 1 >= 0 else depot
                        ins_right = rb[p] if p < Lrb else depot
                        ins_delta_b = -matrix[ins_left][ins_right] + matrix[ins_left][node] + matrix[node][ins_right]
                        total_delta = (new_cost_a + (base_cost_b + ins_delta_b)) - (base_cost_a + base_cost_b)
                        # Accept only improving (strict). Deterministic tie: prefer smaller total_delta then smaller p.
                        if best_delta is None or total_delta < best_delta - 1e-12 or (abs(total_delta - best_delta) <= 1e-12 and p < best_p):
                            best_delta = total_delta
                            best_p = p

                    if best_delta is None or best_delta >= -1e-12:
                        continue

                    # Apply move
                    new_ra = ra[:idx] + ra[idx + 1:]
                    new_rb = rb[:best_p] + [node] + rb[best_p:]
                    routes[a] = new_ra
                    routes[b] = new_rb
                    loads[a] -= demands[node]
                    loads[b] += demands[node]

                    costs[a] = new_cost_a
                    # update cost_b
                    # compute new cost_b exactly using insertion delta
                    costs[b] = base_cost_b + (best_delta - (new_cost_a - base_cost_a))
                    improved_any = True
                    break
                if improved_any:
                    break
            if improved_any:
                break
        if not improved_any:
            break

    # Final cleanup: remove empty routes
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    return routes
